14:47 < antagonizt> keep too many connections from the same ip?
14:47 < Filip> A module for Apache 1.3 giving Apache the ability to fend off request-based DoS 
14:47 < Filip> attacks conserving your system resources and bandwidth. This new tool maintains 
14:47 < Filip> an internal table of IP addresses and URLs and will deny repeated requests for t 
14:47 < Filip> he same URL from the same IP address, blacklisting the address for 10-seconds pe 
14:47 < Filip> r extraneous request.
14:47 < antagonizt> cool
14:48 < Filip> I already had protsentry installed for 6 months or so to lock-out people doing portscans
14:48 < Filip> =portsentry
14:48 < hewhew> you want a mirror?
14:48 < Filip> but the recent attacks used a valid http requests, but massive amounts for the same pages with no-cache headers
14:49 < Filip> mirror is not easy at all for b-central, since it's completely database driven.
14:49 < Filip> each page is generated at request time from scripts and database data
14:49 < hewhew> heh ok
14:50 < Filip> that's also why it's prettymemory and cpu intensive
14:50 < antagonizt> we just need to make sure not to get a story on slashdot...

14:51 < Filip> slashdot should not be a problem for linux4.be, it would be for be-central
14:52 < Filip> it's a matter of minutes to replace dynamic content with static copies of it, and the complete site can run from memory
